title: Lockable Shelves
description: Allows shelves to be locked by redstone signals. The signal to lock a slot is the same as the signal a comparator reads when an item is in the slot. Hotbar swapping now happens at redstone strength above 7.
body:
Allows shelves to be locked by redstone signals. 

The signal to lock a slot is the same as the signal a comparator reads when an item is in the slot.

Hotbar swapping now happens at redstone strength above 7.
